title: Sahara
description: A treasure hunter (Matthew McConaughey) and his sidekick (Steve Zahn) join forces with a doctor (Penélope Cruz) to search for a Confederate ship in Africa.

title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: Uncommon Valor
description: A colonel with a sponsor leads five Marine veterans into Laos to find his son and others missing in action.

title: Scrooge
description: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Albert Finney) meets the spirits of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

title: The Weather Man
description: A Chicago weather forecaster (Nicolas Cage) tries to mend relations with his father (Michael Caine), his ex-wife (Hope Davis) and his two children.

title: Apocalypse Now Redux
description: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando).

title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
description: A Memphis law school graduate (Matt Damon) aids a battered wife (Claire Danes) and fights a corporate lawyer (Jon Voight) for insurance benefits for a dying man.

title: The Outsiders
description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

title: The Mechanic
description: An elite hitman teaches his trade to an apprentice who has a connection to one of his previous victims.

title: First Blood
description: Green Beret veteran Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a Pacific Northwest sheriff (Brian Dennehy) and the National Guard.

title: Ghost
description: A slain Manhattan yuppie (Patrick Swayze) reaches out to his lover (Demi Moore), with a medium (Whoopi Goldberg) as his middle woman.

title: Twister
description: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

title: 48 HRS.
description: A rumpled detective gets a slick convict released into his custody for two days to help him find a murderer in San Francisco.

title: Faster
description: A veteran cop (Billy Bob Thornton) and an assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen) track an ex-convict (Dwayne Johnson) who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers.

title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
description: After serving time for a crime he did not commit, a vengeful barber (Johnny Depp) and his accomplice (Helena Bonham Carter) carve up unlucky customers and bake them in meat pies.

title: The Untouchables
description: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force.

title: An Officer and a Gentleman
description: A hardened loner (Richard Gere) shapes up for a military drill instructor (Louis Gossett Jr.) and a factory girl (Debra Winger) from town.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: Serendipity
description: A man (John Cusack) and a woman (Kate Beckinsale) try to find each other after spending one night together 10 years earlier.

title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
description: New York playgirl Holly Golightly puzzles a writer who lives in her building.

title: Urban Cowboy
description: A Texas farmer (John Travolta) moves to the city, immerses himself in honky-tonk and falls for a sexy cowgirl (Debra Winger).

title: The Hunt for Red October
description: Moscow, Washington and a CIA analyst (Alec Baldwin) track a renegade Soviet captain (Sean Connery) and his new submarine.

title: Beautiful Girls
description: The opposite sex preoccupies working-class pals gathered for their high-school reunion in small-town Massachusetts.

title: Norbit
description: Though married to a terrible shrew, a man (Eddie Murphy) tries to figure out a way to be with his childhood sweetheart (Thandie Newton), who has just moved back into town.

title: Shakespeare in Love
description: Young William Shakespeare (Joseph Fiennes) falls for Viola (Gwyneth Paltrow), reawakening his creativity, but she is betrothed to Wessex.

title: Cold Mountain
description: During the Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier (Jude Law) abandons his duties to make his way home to his sweetheart (Nicole Kidman).

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: Scream 2
description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

title: View From the Top
description: A woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) from a small Nevada town makes friends while training to become a flight attendant.

title: The Stepford Wives
description: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality.

title: Days of Thunder
description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself.

title: Cold Mountain
description: During the Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier (Jude Law) abandons his duties to make his way home to his sweetheart (Nicole Kidman).

title: Blue Valentine
description: A couple (Ryan Gosling, Michelle Williams) find that they are powerless to stop the downward spiral of their marriage.

title: The Terminal
description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport.

title: Shall We Dance?
description: A married Chicago attorney (Richard Gere) takes dancing lessons with a beautiful woman (Jennifer Lopez) he saw through a window.

title: The Firm
description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

title: Hard Eight
description: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular.

title: Failure to Launch
description: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

title: Scream 4
description: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour.

title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
description: A Memphis law school graduate (Matt Damon) aids a battered wife (Claire Danes) and fights a corporate lawyer (Jon Voight) for insurance benefits for a dying man.

title: Mr. Holmes
description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

title: Dinner for Schmucks
description: Comic misadventures follow when a rising executive (Paul Rudd) brings a blundering IRS agent (Steve Carell) to a monthly gathering hosted by his boss.

title: A Night at the Roxbury
description: Desperate to meet women and open their own dance club, brainless brothers Steve (Will Ferrell) and Doug Butabi (Chris Kattan) cruise Beverly Hills.

title: Happy Christmas
description: An immature party girl (Anna Kendrick) moves in with her brother's family to get over a breakup and throws their lives out of whack.
